Thank you!
Meklit was the best server ever! She made our dining experience unforgettable. I would definitely come back. Give her a raise!!
Will, Karina, Michael and Meklit were an absolute delight. And thank you to Derks for the apps and keeping my beer full!

The food here is amazing. I ordered something simple: the breakfast sandwich. I didn't expect much because it's just an egg and bacon sandwich. But, as is known in the culinary industry, the simplest dishes are the greatest test of skill. The egg was cooked to perfection. The bacon was crispy but not overcooked. The sauce was flavourful. Even the side salad struck the perfect balance between sharp cheese and aromatic peppercorns. The food was a delightful pairing with my $5 house lager, which was light and very drinkable.

Our server, Ewin, always made sure we had everything we needed. He even remembered everyone's name in a table of 6! He checked in regularly so I could refill my alcohol at a good pace. His friendly and personable service brightened up the experience.

Finally, the music played here is just one banger after another.  I normally don't like loud music but I loved every song that played here. It makes for an exciting but subtle background to the lively conversation you're surely having with your friends.

I will definitely be coming back. Update: i came back and had Aisia as my server. She was very pleasant and helpful!
Family party for 25. Great food and the staff was amazing!  Thank you Karina and Nicky!

Danielle truly made our experience unforgettable! She was incredibly kind, friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Her warm personality and genuine care made us feel so comfortable and special. She went above and beyond to make sure we had a wonderful experience, and honestly, people like Danielle are what make a place stand out. The café is lovely, but Danielle is definitely the highlight! We’ll absolutely be coming back. Thank you, Danielle, for making our visit so special! ❤️
Danielle was an excellent waitress! She was very kind, attentive, and knowledgeable about the restaurant. We felt extremely welcomed and valued, thank you for such a wonderful experience!
Danielle was really nice! She was extremely welcoming, and she accommodated really nicely for our party of 8! As someone new to Canada, it was incredibly nice to get this kind of service.
DANIELLE!!! She was amazing

DANIELLE was kind, patient, nice, marvelous, wonderful, animated, and maybe the most amazing server I've ever had! DANIELLE was so careful to make sure the birthday girl had an amazing time, asked for allergies, and did ALL the things she was trained to do AND MORE. DANIELLEEEEE WAS A GREAT WAITRESS TONIGHT.

We hosted our family on the rooftop space to celebrate our daughter’s baptism. The process to book was super simple and we love local because there is something for everyone on their great menu. The day of, our service Kalypsa was incredible making sure everything we preordered came out asap, drinks were served quickly, food orders were taken, and dessert and coffee were offered quickly after (just in time when we needed some caffeine boost)! She went above and beyond and made the whole morning seamless for us, which really allowed us to enjoy the day as she did all the hosting for us (making sure we always had drinks topped up, helping with recommendations, and even just some great chats!). The day was wonderful, but our servers really made us feel special and well taken care of.
Amazing ambience, great food! Special shoutout to our server Kalypsa who was awesome!

My son and I go there for lunch and a catch up, amazing food and great service , Kalypsa is a fantastic server and every thing she recommends is fantastic , I’m celiac and they have great options for me. I highly recommend the fish tacos
Great and fast Kalypsa was great

Not your typical bland, subpar, overpriced restaurant by any means.

What a phenomenal experience?!!! The wait staff , hostess , chef , and bar tender were exceptional.

The highlight of this gem was the incredible food; nothing pre packaged, absolutely fresh, and made with LOVE. A++++++ to this chef and kitchen staff. It has been years since I genuinely raved about a meal at a restaurant.

My waiter HARRISON made our night with his top notch customer service skills, knowledge, and overall kindness. LPE should recognize this employee for his contribution to their brand by setting them above the rest.

My only very very slight criticism would be the music level - it is quite overpowering upon entering the establishment. The music playlist itself however fit the atmosphere perfectly.

Btw , LOVE the quiz night incorporation, next level in trending!
